answer: Each new agent must lock a ferrous stake inside a time-delayed vault whose unbonding spans several epochs, with withdrawals gated by a unique hardware key. An atlas of deposit histories is gossiped among attestors so they can reject identities funded from the same parent wallet or that unbond in lockstep, slashing the shared stake. Raising many fake names then costs real locked capital and waiting time, which cheap sybil swarms cannot afford.
